items.title: The Next Phase of Webull Could Be the One That Matters Most
items.summary: Webull just posted a record trading quarter, eliminated a regulatory headwind it called its defining moment, and closed a major international acquisition, yet the stock is down 34% over the past year. Whether the next phase of its story corrects that or deepens it depends on a few things falling into place.

items.title: ‘We Asked ChatGPT and It Said to Realize Gains’: But CFP Wes Moss Says Don’t Withdraw a Dime
items.summary: A Texas family used ChatGPT to build an income plan around a brokerage account, and a certified financial planner stopped them before they made a move that would have triggered taxes they never needed to pay.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Brings AI Tools to 16,000 Financial Advisors
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) is partnering with Anthropic to roll out the Claude for Financial Advisors tool to its RIA network. The AI assistant is being integrated into the workflows of more than 16,000 independent advisors that custody with Schwab. Claude is expected to support tasks such as drafting client communications, summarizing documents, and assisting with research for advisory teams. items.title: ‘Wait Till They’re No Longer a Dependent’: Wes Moss’s Warning on the Trump-to-Roth Hack
items.summary: Thousands of families plan to convert their child's Trump Account to a Roth IRA at 18, but one tax mechanic can quietly erase the entire benefit and send that bill straight to the parents.

items.title: Schwab Books a Record August With $64.8 Billion of Net New Assets
items.summary: Margin balances ended August at $177.6 billion, up 92% year over year

items.title: Charles Schwab Net New Assets Hit $64.8 Billion in August, a Record for the Month
items.summary: Charles Schwab’s  stock was rising Tuesday morning after it reported hauling in $64.8 billion in core net new assets, a record for the month of August.  Analysts watch the company’s asset-gathering figures closely to see how quickly Schwab is growing.  The company said customers opened 424,000 new brokerage accounts in August, an increase of 11% compared with August 2025.
